result:
Both findings are repaired in the two e2e spec files, and both specs now pass on the real stack. The changes are uncommitted for you to integrate. Every required check exited 0; the only non-zero exit was the intended reproduction of F-DG5-143 before the fix. The full suites were not run, as D-164 requires (see the end).

**F-DG5-143 (Medium): the auditor test failed in Arabic**
- **Cause:** the check for approve/move buttons in `p3-prioritization-roadmap.spec.ts` matched part of a word. The new slips-table sort header «الاعتمادية» ("dependency") contains the letters of «اعتماد» ("approve"), so it was counted as a write control. The product itself was correct.
- **Failing before:** I reproduced it on the real stack: 12 passed, 1 failed (`:542`, chromium-ar), 1 did not run.
- **Fix:** the check now matches approve, move, «اعتماد» and «نقل» only as whole words. It still checks every button on the three screens, sort headers included, so it is no weaker. No product label changed.
- **Regression test:** inside the same test, the matcher must catch all six approve/move write labels from the catalogue and must reject five read-only labels, including «الاعتمادية».
- **After:** 14/14 passed with the locale unset and with C.UTF-8. The Arabic screenshot shows the auditor's read-only Dependencies page with that sort header present.
- **Other specs:** none had the same pattern, so no other spec changed. The p3-journeys auditor sweep already skips table headers.

**F-DG5-144 (Low): p4-raid-governance test 5 timed out under load**
- **Fix:** an explicit 90 s budget, plus a timing note per phase so a slow run names the slow phase. No step or assertion changed.
- **Not split:** unlike F-DG5-141, the test is one serial chain over two signed-in users, so I couldn't split it.
- **Why 90 s:** that is three times qa's 30.1 s cut-off run, and more than three times every completed loaded run (21.6–27.8 s).
- **Failing before:** I didn't reproduce the timeout myself, because it only appears under full-suite load. The handback cites an excerpt of qa's round-2 log instead.
- **After:** 14/14 passed in three runs: two with the locale unset (one of them on the final file) and one with C.UTF-8. Test 5 took 13–15 s; tests 6 and 7, which hadn't run in qa's run, now pass.

| Check | Exit | Result |
|---|---|---|
| DG4 historical validation, at start and end | 0 / 0 | PASS |
| `pnpm -r typecheck`, `pnpm -r build`, `pnpm lint`, prettier check, `pnpm openapi:lint` | all 0 | |
| `unit-web` Vitest, locale unset / C.UTF-8 | 0 / 0 | 1746 passed each |

- **Not run (D-164):** `pnpm test`, `pnpm test:integration` and the full e2e suite are left to your merged-tree verification.
- **Contract and dependencies:** no change, and none needed. No user-facing text, ADR or data-dictionary statement is affected.
- **Untracked files I didn't create:** `CLAUDE.local.md` and some top-level dotfiles (`.bashrc`, `.mcp.json`, `.vscode`, …). I left them alone; they aren't part of this change.

Files are in `/home/user/wt/dg5-fe-rg2`:
- `apps/web/e2e/p3-prioritization-roadmap.spec.ts`
- `apps/web/e2e/p4-raid-governance.spec.ts`
- `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG5/T-DG5-FE-RG2-frontend-ux-engineer.md`
- `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG5/T-DG5-FE-RG2-evidence/` (logs, reports, screenshots and the run script)
